modelDescription: The B-14 Wilderness Series embodies pure performance. Real-world feature sets like fluted bolts, specialized coatings, and stock options can withstand the rugged and unforgiving wilderness while blending into those very same elements. This series is for the backcountry, to match every stride you take off the beaten trail. The SIERRA stock has an adjustable cheek comb and length adjustment (L.O.P.) capabilities to adapt to the hunter but achieve a reduced weight and a classic stock style. It is a complete all-around rifle that also comes in a wide variety of calibers and is also available for left-handed shooters.
